reports.desc: I ordered a product that was never delivered. They insisted package was delivered, but my local post office stated the tracking number given did not exist. After several attemps, they refused to refund. Also, there was no mention product was not made in USA and would be shipped from a different country.

Fake seller trying to scam people by listing Lume Deodorant products at very cheap prices. Normally a stick of deodorant is around $17-$20, but these were listed at $1-$2 each. The contact us page was very suspicious. The email listed was an IUBRIDGE email address, which is associated with scammers.
I dont know who it is but it definitely isn't Wade Chambers.
I ordered from John and Ave in July.  Never received my product.  Gave me a so called tracking number that can it be tracked and when I go to contact them...the contact goes nowhere.
checkout counter .Card not accepted  for some reason.It means they have all info involving details especially card holder name and address, codes and exp date

Bladetrade on facebook is a scam. Finally returned my email after they discovered my credit card dispute. Sent me a tracking number in Chinese. It didn’t work. Asked me to cancel dispute. I told them I would after the product was delivered.

Ordered a part that was never received...emails went unanswered...when answered they mention they work multiple jobs and had to see if they even had the part and mentions they will get back but never Attempted to notify any updates....

Website promised GPS tracker compatible with Apple Find My. Tracker refused to connect with the Find My app and did not work reliably with their app called iSearching. Spent all day going back and forth with a tech support person and could not resolve the problem.
Was contacted by Glen (get-ITagPro.com) who offered 25% credit of the original purchase price to avoid having to ship the tags back to them. In addition they had to be unopened and unused!
I was having problems with my printer. I called the Cannon phone number and was told that there was site blocking my use of printer.

This is a company that claims to want to feature author’s books and help promote them. They contact you through email to say how well your book is doing on Amazon and how they can help give you more visibility. Their website looks real. For an annual fee of $25 you can have your book featured, which they did. But then they ask if you want to have your book in literary magazines like the Paris review. That was $80. I have yet to see that article or the grants that I applied for. And now they do not respond to email, their Facebook page no longer exists, and you can’t call them or submit a customer service request.

I purchased 2 pairs of shoes and never received my shoes. I called and left a message. I received a call back telling me that someone was taking payments, that the company didn't exist and the phone number used was a different store.
They tried to offer me a fake loan.
